goal: Read how the November 1989 fall of the Berlin Wall and the December 1989 Malta Summit, where Bush and Gorbachov jointly declared the Cold War over, marked a turning point that would reach Latin America too.

items: Describe what happened in Berlin on November 9, 1989.
Explain what Bush and Gorbachov declared at Malta.
Describe what happened to Eastern European communist governments.
Explain why this mattered for Latin America specifically.
Use marcar un antes y un después for a historical turning point.
